datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Liberia in 2016. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. Data were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for February, June, and October 2016 projections.
